messages:
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-472 triggered for eu-west: elevated 5xx rate and timeouts on inference endpoints. Paging @alex (oncall).

alex: I'm on it, checking ingress and GPU pool routing. Can someone draft a concise customer-facing status update we can publish now? Keeping it short: impact, affected endpoints, and cadence for updates.

kelsey: Drafting — please review: "We are investigating increased error rates affecting generation and chat requests in the eu-west region. Some requests may fail with 500 or experience higher latency. Our engineering team is actively investigating. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."

maria: Suggest adding affected endpoints + a lightweight workaround if possible: Affected: `/v1/generate`, `/v1/chat/completions`. Workaround: retrying requests or routing to another region reduces errors for most customers. Also mark severity as "partial degradation".

samir: +1. Also add ETA for next update: 30 minutes from now, and note we are evaluating SLA impact. Avoid root cause statements until confirmed.

kelsey: Updated draft: "We are investigating increased error rates affecting generation and chat requests in the eu-west region (endpoints: `/v1/generate`, `/v1/chat/completions`). Some requests may fail with a 500 error or see higher latency. Workaround: retry your request or consider routing to another region. Our engineering team is actively investigating and evaluating customer impact; we will post updates every 30 minutes."

alex: Good — publish this as the initial statuspage entry. Use severity: partial_degradation. Post internal note here when published so we can coordinate customer DMs.

statuspage-bot: Initial update published to status.redwood.com: "Increased error rates in eu-west - Investigating" (severity: partial_degradation). Link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-472

ops-bot: 1st follow-up (15m): We observed elevated errors correlated with a routing change that shifted a portion of traffic to a degraded GPU pool. Engineers are rolling back the routing change now and monitoring error rates.

alex: Rollback initiated, ETA for stabilization ~10 minutes. Preparing customer DM draft for impacted accounts.

maria: Draft DM snippet: "We're investigating increased errors in eu-west and have initiated mitigations. We expect service to stabilize shortly. We'll follow up with a full update when we confirm recovery and an RCA."

samir: Can we add list of affected customers (internal) so support knows who to escalate? I'll DM the billing list separately.

statuspage-bot: 2nd update published: "Mitigation in progress — rollback of recent routing change underway; monitoring for recovery. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner."

ops-bot: 3rd update (recovery check): Error rate trending down to baseline, tail latency improving. Continuing to monitor for 30 minutes.

alex: Confirmed stabilization across eu-west. No additional customer action required. Preparing resolved notice.

kelsey: Proposed resolved copy: "Resolved: The incident impacting generation and chat requests in eu-west has been mitigated. Errors and latency have returned to normal levels. Root cause: a routing change that directed traffic to a degraded GPU pool. We have rolled back the change and are conducting a full RCA. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with request IDs."

maria: Add link to support and note for enterprise customers to expect an email with more details/RCA when ready.

statuspage-bot: Resolved update published: "Resolved — Traffic routing rollback mitigated errors in eu-west. Full RCA forthcoming." (final) Link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-472/resolved

ops-bot: Closing notes: internal postmortem owner assigned (samir). Timeline and RCA draft due EOD. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
